name: io.github.gonnagetapower/kelvia-mcp
title: Kelvia
description: Task manager your agent can fully operate: boards, tasks, sprints, roles, worklogs, day planner.

environmentVariables.name: KELVIA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kelvia agent key (create one in Kelvia → Profile → Agents)

environmentVariables.name: KELVIA_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: boards, tasks, comments, stages, members, planner, tags. Defaults to all.
